At the start of the meeting, Ali walks to the front and gives a speech, then turns to Dahao, and says in a challenging tone: "Dahao, do you have confidence to take on this heavy responsibility?" Because his legs and feet are a bit inconvenient. Ali smiles and turns to Xiaofei, saying in the same tone: "Xiaofei, do you have the courage to accept this challenge?" Xiaofei immediately nods in agreement.

[Question]
What does Ali do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Ali invites Dahao to be responsible for the patrol work.
B. Ali blames Dahao for not wanting to take on the responsibility of a volunteer.
C. Ali chooses to be responsible for the patrol work herself.
